title: BT L2CAP: Check FCS
description:
The Bluetooth L2CAP FCS is the "plain" CRC-16 (x^16 + x^15 + x^2 + 1)
with a zero seed. See 3.3.5 of the L2CAP specification:

https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/Core-54/out/en/host/logical-link-control-and-adaptation-protocol-specification.html#UUID-8a480d72-726c-479f-1624-9c0819950db1

The capture file in #2241 has examples of the FCS, which all compute
as correct with this change.
